newsitem.title: UK: UK's Alizyme eyes Japanese collaborations.
newsitem.headline: UK's Alizyme eyes Japanese collaborations.

text.p: UK biotech firm Alizyme Plc said on Tuesday said it hired Japanese trading house Nichimen Corp to assist it in talks with Japan's pharmaceutical companies on potential collaborations.
The company said introductory meetings had taken place with several undisclosed Japanese firms.
Alizyme also said it had exercised its option to an exclusive, worldwide licence for a gastrointestinal drug from the Rowett Research Institute in Aberdeen, Scotland.
The company said it expected to move into preclinical development before the end of the year for the treatment of the gastrointestinal side effects of cancer chemotherapy.
In addition, Alizyme said it agreed to a three-year collaboration on potential treatments for obesity with the Royal Postgraduate Medical School in London.
